subject: Workplace Skills
title: When Email Is the Wrong Tool
description: A quick, practical guide to When Email Is the Wrong Tool.

hook.text: A 47-email thread about a lunch order could have been one group chat message.

buildup.text: Email works well for formal requests and documentation. It fails for quick back-and-forth decisions.

discovery.text: Chat tools suit rapid exchanges. Calls suit nuance. Docs suit collaboration. Email suits records.

twist.text: Choosing the wrong channel doesn't just waste time — it changes how the message is received.

climax.text: Before writing an email, ask: could a two-minute call or a chat message resolve this faster?

punchline.text: Pick the channel that matches the conversation.

quiz.question: When is email the best communication channel?
options: For brainstorming ideas with a team
